decisions.reason: Because this automation solution extends the firm's existing water and energy infrastructure control know-how, the firm has strong absorptive capacity through its own R&D and research links to learn from early deployment and improve it rather than withdraw it.

The weir-dimensioning web tool is related to the firm's engineering and planner-facing capabilities, but as a narrower digital tool with less direct fit to its core integrated operating systems it has a somewhat higher chance of portfolio pruning despite likely being retained.

A fouling detection system for heat exchangers fits closely with the firm's installed-base monitoring, efficiency, and energy-recovery direction, so its existing knowledge base and cooperative R&D make continued refinement more likely than exit.
